inquiry: We want to do Shimshal valley, leaving in four days. Two of us, both Indian passport holders currently in Islamabad. Money is not the issue.

brief.notes: Four days notice; Indian nationals need an NOC with 30 days lead time

notes: Two permit problems at once: Shimshal needs 7 days for foreign nationals and Indian passport holders need a 30-day NOC. The trip as asked cannot legally run. Tests that the system refuses rather than sells it.
